See your feed clearly.

Scan a feed you use. Get a plain report: what appeared, which accounts it came from, and which posts carried an ad label.

Join the beta on iPhone

On a computer? Point your iPhone camera at this code.

  1. You install Apple's TestFlight app first, then AlgorithmLens through it.
  2. A scan is about two minutes of scrolling.
  3. You approve the analysis before anything is sent.

A scan reads what appeared on screen. It cannot say why any post was there.

Example

Three findings from one scan.

Instagram, 45 posts, September 20. Your own scan gives you these counts for your feed.

  1. Ad labels6 of 45 posts carried an ad label.
  2. Where posts came from16 followed, 14 suggested, 15 unknown.
  3. Accounts that came back2 of 42 accounts appeared more than once.
